Messages.Author: Bell
Messages.Body:
Swarm bleeding is the end game with this deck, although just as often it seemed the Arms Dealers were there for me to block rushes against minions I really cared about.

Spirit Marionette gave me the ability to play "tap and bleed" to some extent as well as allowing my prey to do horrible things to my predator's minions at times.

It was a lot of fun and was fairly resilient by having cheap minions and a lot of ways to put blood back on my key vampires. Ashur Tablets assured I would virtually never run out of Arms Dealers, in the final I did find myself with all my Brujah rushed so much that I was unable to recruit more Arms Dealers.
